title: Kodak to highlight packaging solutions at TOKYO PACK 2026
summary: Kodak will showcase its packaging solutions at TOKYO PACK 2026, taking place October 14–16 at Tokyo Big Sight. At booth 8C13 in East Hall 8, Kodak will…
body_markdown:
Kodak will showcase its packaging solutions at[TOKYO PACK 2026](https://www.tokyo-pack.jp/) , taking place **October 14–16** at **Tokyo Big Sight** . At booth **8C13** in **East Hall 8** , Kodak will show how its offset, digital and software solutions can help printers and converters produce more flexible, efficient and value-added packaging.


At the show, Kodak will showcase[KODAK SONORA XTRA Process Free Plates](https://www.kodak.com/en/print/product/offset/plates/sonora-xtra/) ,[KODAK TRENDSETTER Platesetter](https://www.kodak.com/en/print/product/offset/ctp-systems/trendsetter-q1600-platesetter/) ,[KODAK PROSPER Imprinting Systems](https://www.kodak.com/en/print/page/imprinting-systems/) ,[KODAK SPOTLESS Software](https://www.kodak.com/content/pdfs/print/KODAK-SPOTLESS-Software-datasheet-EN.pdf) , and[KODAK COLORFLOW PRO Software](https://www.kodak.com/content/pdfs/print/KODAK-COLORFLOW-Pro-Software-datasheet-EN.pdf) . Visitors will see a range of print samples that highlight the versatility, quality and performance of Kodak’s packaging solutions.


Kodak leads the market with innovations in highly efficient and sustainable process-free plate technology with KODAK SONORA XTRA Plates made in Japan, imaged on a KODAK TRENDSETTER Platesetter. The platesetter can also image TRF-IR830 Thermal Laser Film from Mitsubishi Paper Mills. This dry film offers an efficient computer-to-film solution for flexo/letterpress printing, screen printing and printed circuit board applications.


KODAK PROSPER Imprinting Systems add digital capabilities to analog print, enabling hybrid production without sacrificing throughput. Designed for integration with offset, flexo and gravure presses, and finishing equipment, they help printers expand their capabilities within existing production workflows.


KODAK SPOTLESS Software uses process inks to reproduce spot colors, enabling converters to reduce ink inventory, costs and makeready time. KODAK COLORFLOW PRO Software supports consistent color across equipment and substrates, meeting Japan Color and G7 standards while maintaining accurate output throughout the workflow.


"Packaging printers need connected solutions that add flexibility without adding complexity," said Takeshi Nakagawa, Japan Sales Director, Kodak. "TOKYO PACK 2026 gives us the opportunity to show how Kodak’s portfolio supports a more responsive and efficient packaging production."
